Find unused types, members, and files

Usage: roe dead-code [OPTIONS] [PATH]

Arguments:
  [PATH]  Path to the codebase root (defaults to the current directory)

Options:
  -f, --format <FORMAT>  Output format [default: human] [possible values: human, json]
      --aggressive       Also flag enum members and public settable auto-properties
      --root <FQN>       Additional entry-point roots (fully-qualified symbol names)
      --config <PATH>    Path to an explicit roe.json/roe.yaml/roe.yml config (skips auto-discovery)
  -h, --help             Print help

result.stdout:
Find duplicated code blocks

Usage: roe dupes [OPTIONS] [PATH]

Arguments:
  [PATH]
          Path to the codebase root (defaults to the current directory)

Options:
  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format
          
          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

      --mode <MODE>
          Matching mode

          Possible values:
          - exact:    Exact token match — only verbatim copy-pasted blocks match
          - semantic: Identifiers and numeric literals are normalized to a shared placeholder, so renamed-but-structurally-identical blocks match too
          
          [default: exact]

      --no-code
          Hide the duplicated source code printed under each group (human format only)

      --min-tokens <MIN_TOKENS>
          Minimum token-run length for a match to be reported
          
          [default: 50]

      --min-lines <MIN_LINES>
          Minimum line span (of the shortest occurrence) for a match to be reported
          
          [default: 5]

      --min-occurrences <MIN_OCCURRENCES>
          Minimum number of occurrences for a match to be reported
          
          [default: 2]

      --config <PATH>
          Path to an explicit roe.json/roe.yaml/roe.yml config (skips auto-discovery)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
